) on Friday said it has acquired VORAGO Technologies, a Texas-based provider of radiation-hardened and radiation-tolerant microcontrollers (MCUs) and microprocessors (MPUs).
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
The acquisition is not expected to be material to Microchip's consolidated financial results, the company said.

"With this acquisition, Microchip is positioned to capture a larger share of the A&D and space markets, which have seen accelerating investment and demand across both defense and commercial space programs," Microchip said.

"The acquisition adds a family of radiation-hardened MCUs and MPUs that complement Microchip's existing aerospace and defense product lines, along with VORAGO's patented HARDSIL process technology," the company added.

title: Microchip Technology acquires VORAGO Technologies
